name: Storm Giant

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The giant makes two attacks, using Stone Club or Boulder in any combination.

actions.name: Stone Club
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Boulder
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 60/240 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

reactions.text: Deflect Missile (Recharge 5–6). Trigger: The giant is hit by a ranged attack roll and takes Bludgeoning, Pierc- ing, or Slashing damage from it. Response: The giant reduces the damage it takes from the attack by 11 (1d10 + 6), and if that damage is reduced to 0, the giant can redirect some of the attack’s force. Dexterity Saving

reactions.name: Throw
reactions.text: DC 17, one creature the giant can see within 60 feet. Failure: 11 (1d10 + 6) Force damage. Stone Golem Stone Golem
